updated_by: W4-CC (seed); the integrator owns every later update

schema.doc: Read by app/command_center/company.py (GET /api/cc/completion, Command Center 'Completion' tab). Validated by company.validate_board and tests/test_w4_cc_company.py. Timestamps ISO 8601 UTC. A null is UNKNOWN, never zero.
schema.lane: string, unique: the lane id (e.g. W4-CC)
schema.worker: string: the responsible worker (session / agent / person)
schema.task: string: what the lane is finishing
schema.status: QUEUED | RUNNING | BLOCKED | REVIEW | MERGED | DONE | ABANDONED | UNKNOWN
schema.last_update_at: ISO 8601 or null (unknown); a RUNNING lane older than 3 h shows STALE
schema.useful_output: string or null: the latest verified output (commit, test, artefact)
schema.blocker: string or null: the exact gate holding the lane
